subject: general
question: In June 2025, Canada signed a historic defence agreement with which of the following to strengthen cooperation amid global tensions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**European Union**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **June 2025**, Canada signed a historic **defence agreement** with the **European Union (EU)**. This agreement was aimed at strengthening cooperation in light of increasing **global tensions** and geopolitical challenges.
 
• The agreement focuses on joint efforts in areas such as **cybersecurity, military training, and intelligence sharing**, addressing modern security threats like cyberattacks and hybrid warfare.
 
• The partnership signifies a growing bond between Canada and the **European Union**, highlighting their shared commitment to **upholding democratic values and international peace**.
 
• This defence cooperation is also aligned with NATO’s objectives, as both Canada and most EU member states are part of this military alliance.
 
• The agreement comes at a time when global tensions, particularly in regions like **Eastern Europe** and the **Indo-Pacific**, are reshaping international security dynamics, emphasizing the need for close collaboration among allies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **European Union (EU):**

 
 
• The **European Union** is a political and economic union comprising **27 member countries**, primarily located in Europe.
 
• It was established by the **Maastricht Treaty** in **1993** and has a single market, allowing the free movement of goods, services, capital, and people.
 
• The EU also emphasizes **foreign policy coordination**, defense cooperation, and addressing global challenges like climate change and security threats.
 
 
 
• **Canada's Defence Policies:**
 
 
• Canada actively participates in several international alliances, including **NATO**, and emphasizes multilateral cooperation for global peace and security.
 
• The country has a strong focus on cybersecurity, peacekeeping operations, and countering emerging global threats.
 
 
 
• **Global Tensions in 2025:**
 
 
• Conflicts in regions like **Eastern Europe**, particularly involving **Russia and Ukraine**, have heightened global security concerns.
 
• The rise of **China** as a global power in the **Indo-Pacific region** has also led to increased efforts among Western allies to ensure stability and counterbalance geopolitical shifts.
 
 
 
• **Canada-EU Relations:**
 
 
• Canada and the EU already share strong trade relations through the **Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA)**, which came into effect in **2017**.
 
• The defence agreement further enhances their collaboration, expanding beyond trade to include **security and strategic concerns**.
